title: Embedding Learning for Fine-grained Segmentation
summary: Designed variation-aware proxy learning to improve fine-grained segmentation boundaries with no extra inference cost.
brief: Model-agnostic embedding factorization with variation-aware proxies for fine-grained segmentation.
overview:
[Members] 1

[Period] Mar 2025 - Aug 2025

[Method Design]
Analyzed the limitations of single-proxy representations and designed a factorized similarity computation combining a representative proxy and a variation vector, with Attraction/Repulsion losses - improving boundary quality at no additional parameter or inference cost.

[Experiments & Results]
Validated consistent mIoU gains across 6 backbones (SegNeXt, HRNet, etc.) and 4 datasets (Cityscapes, COCO-Stuff, iSAID, etc.), including MobileNetV3+Cityscapes 69.5->72.3. Published results in a journal paper.

title: Real-time LWIR Segmentation for Firefighter Navigation
summary: Built a noise-robust real-time LWIR segmentation framework for firefighter navigation in low-visibility environments.
brief: Noise-robust real-time LWIR segmentation for firefighter navigation with thermal style augmentation.
overview:
[Members] 2

[Period] Mar 2023 - Feb 2025

[Dataset Construction]
Personally established QC criteria and labeling rules for collected data, and led repeated review cycles to reduce label quality variance.

[Data Diversity]
Designed and applied I2I-based IR style augmentation to reduce location bias, identified its structural limitations firsthand, and proposed the direction for transitioning to diffusion-based methods.

[Framework Design]
Independently designed SDM (noise suppression), BEM (boundary enhancement), and MSFM (local-global feature fusion) to address thermal noise instability.

[Results]
Outperformed FTNet on KERInha (mIoU 67.21) and SODA (mIoU 63.81). Published in a journal paper and recognized with an external award.

title: Building an Auto-Labeling Pipeline for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Built a three-stage auto-labeling pipeline that generated training-ready semantic labels for LWIR images.
brief: Text-prompt-based auto-labeling pipeline for LWIR semantic segmentation using Grounding DINO and SAM.
overview:
[Members] 1

[Period] Apr 2023 - Jun 2023

[Pipeline Design]
Using Grounding DINO and SAM as the baseline, restructured the workflow into a three-stage pipeline: class-wise detection -> instance refinement -> semantic label map construction. Applied text-prompt-based class definition for consistency, and built retry/exception-handling loops at each stage.

[Instance Refinement]
Incorporated class-specific priors (door: vertical structure, floor: lower-connected wide region) to improve mask quality.

[Results]
Generated label maps for 1,820 LWIR images, with the pipeline designed for reuse on newly collected data.

title: FiYS: Multimodal Shoes Search via Context Optimization
summary: Developed a CoOp-based multimodal shoe retrieval system that combines image and text queries for accurate search.
brief: Multimodal retrieval with CoOp-based context tuning for accurate shoe search.
overview:
[Members] 3

[Period] Aug 2022 - Dec 2022

[Dataset Construction]
Contributed to building a custom dataset of 6,000 shoe images spanning 7 brands and 97 models. Defined the attribute information to be stored per image and established exclusion criteria - including cropped, unidentifiable, and low-quality samples - to set the data quality standard for the project.

[Model Selection]
Compared three prompt learning configurations - CLIP baseline, CoOp, and CoCoOp - and derived the rationale for selecting CoOp as the final model, based on its stronger performance in the closed-set attribute classification setting.

[Results]
Classification accuracy improved across all attributes over the hand-crafted prompt baseline, with the largest gains observed in attributes most sensitive to prompt phrasing.
